description: Unit test class for JsonObjectValueValidator, testing validation logic for JsonObject values in headers.

classes.name: JsonObjectValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of JsonObjectValueValidator, including immutability, null handling, and JSON validation.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes a validJsonObjectString with a JSON representation of a JsonObject.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that JsonObjectValueValidator instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Verifies that passing a null definition to accept() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Verifies that passing a null value to accept() throws DittoHeaderInvalidException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Checks that a valid JSON object string is accepted without exception.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotJsonObject
methods.description: Ensures that the validator does not throw an exception for a string that isn't a JSON object (but acceptable in context).

methods.name: acceptNonJsonObjectString
methods.description: Verifies that an invalid JSON string causes a DittoHeaderInvalidException.
